scope: 121 distinct visual dramaturgy contracts with protected intent and artist interpretive space; no illustration, render, PDF, contact sheet, print package, copy change, mechanic change or release lock.

authority.art_direction: Creative system and brief recommendation only.

excluded_visual_sources.technical_index_use: Card identity, exact unchanged copy and PDF mapping verification only.
excluded_visual_sources.style_only_attachment: KAPTAN — abstract print warmth/matte hierarchy only; no character, face, pose, composition, object, bird, ship, hat, border or line copying.

open_risks.statement: v2.6 locked records and active v2.7 Card Texts disagree over GUC-22/GUC-23 identity. Manifest preserves active v2.7 exact copy and records the conflict; it does not resolve it.

required_field_contract.exact_copy: Verbatim structured copy from the cited source; not art-direction-authored.
required_field_contract.first_two_seconds_emotion: One dominant immediate affect at print-card scale.
required_field_contract.visual_narrative_aim: What the image must make the mechanic/identity feel without rewriting it.
required_field_contract.subject_character_event_identity: Who or what carries the scene.
required_field_contract.line_hatching_palette_approach: Material-specific engraved line and matte color logic.
required_field_contract.secondary_wordless_joke_max_one: Zero or one; never signage, speech or mascot.
required_field_contract.similarity_risk_with_other_cards: Known collision to inspect in contact sheet.
required_field_contract.visual_rhythm_role_in_deck: How the card changes scale/value/geometry/human density.
required_field_contract.protected_intent: Binding emotional, gameplay and uncertainty contract; this outranks literal compliance with the initial object/camera proposal.
required_field_contract.artist_interpretive_space: Explicit decisions the artist may re-author while preserving exact identity, mechanic, period, rhythm and spoiler boundaries.
required_field_contract.rename_resilience: Card-level test that current proper nouns do not become readable copy, heraldry, architecture branding, color code or repeated motif.
required_field_contract.director_question: The critique question used before checking polish; it is not an image-generation prompt.
required_field_contract.artist_value_add_target: Where observation and authorship should enter instead of checklist compliance.

global_prohibitions: No rejected e91581 artwork as visual basis or inspiration plate.
No reused human model in costume variants.
No beard or moustache as default sailor identity.
No recurring gull, rat, parrot or incompetent-crew mascot.
No readable in-art writing, logo, slogan, sign, speech balloon or meaningless script.
No exact-copy, identity, mechanic, lore, governance, release or lock change.
No final art, render, PDF, contact sheet or print package in this workstream.

review_input.project_owner_direction: Re-read the actual game and deep research art-direction practice; preserve Chief Editor constraints, avoid proper-name lock-in, and restore artistic taste and illustrator authorship.

rework_summary.joke_policy: NONE is the default. A retained secondary wordless joke requires a card-specific identity or dramaturgy reason and remains subordinate to the main action.
rework_summary.narrative_spine: Added without forcing the story onto all 121 cards; applications are limited and spoiler-safe.
rework_summary.character_collision_audit: KAR-01/KAR-05 and KAR-04/KAR-06 foundations separated; KAR-02/KAR-15 secondary collision resolved; full 20-character matrix lives in the Bible.
rework_summary.single_action_audit: All 121 single_main_action fields manually reviewed; ambiguous alternatives and independent dual actions removed.
rework_summary.lighthouse_period_audit: No catoptric metal reflector, Argand, Fresnel, electric, glow or modern beacon logic; 1721-defensible coal fire, candle or simple oil light only.
rework_summary.game_literacy_pass: Locked v2.6 rulebook and v2.7 story overlay re-read. Visual principles now derive from private information, public route voting, transferable Captaincy, two-hull fragility, scurvy/island pressure and Port Night.
rework_summary.artistic_thesis: WET_WITNESS / ISLAK_TANIKLIK — internal critique lens only, never in-world copy, logo or motif.
rework_summary.brief_contract: Every record now separates protected intent, collision guardrails and starting vectors. The brief is not an image-generation prompt or a locked shot list.
rework_summary.name_resilience: Current proper nouns remain exact source coordinates, but no visual depends on readable names, initials, crests, fixed architecture or a recurring black motif.

creative_operating_system.core_thesis: FOULWAKE is the burden of steering with incomplete testimony, not a pirate-adventure costume layer.
creative_operating_system.internal_taste_lens: ISLAK TANIKLIK / WET WITNESS — event clear, cause and moral judgment incomplete.
creative_operating_system.serious_world_imperfect_people: Humor is optional behavioral residue under pressure, never a mandatory punchline or a second joke added by the image.
creative_operating_system.brief_is_not_prompt: The record defines what must feel true, what must remain unreadable or unresolved, and how it differs in the deck. Camera, micro-gesture and equivalent period props remain open when they improve those truths.
creative_operating_system.artist_role: Visual author and observer within protected intent; not a renderer of a complete object list.
creative_operating_system.art_director_role: Protect emotional/gameplay/world/deck truth; evaluate better artist solutions even when they depart from the starting vector.
critique_order: First-two-seconds emotion and single visual predicate
Silhouette, spatial hierarchy and real-card-size readability
Line, hatching, matte palette and deck rhythm
creative_operating_system.thumbnail_rule: After production authorization, each pilot begins with three black-and-white thumbnails: direct vector, material/negative-space alternative, and one defensible rejection of the obvious solution.
gameplay_anchors: Private horizon information and possible lies: show an event without proving motive.
Public simultaneous route vote: social pressure lives in space, hands and access, not villain faces.
Captaincy is powerful, transferable and not proof of Loyalty.
Two Hull means heavy damage is grave, never slapstick.
Scurvy turns Islands into relief, delay and suspicion at once.
Arrival precedes Port Night; destination is threshold, not triumph.
Loyalty remains hidden even in death; no moral color, face or emblem leakage.

proper_name_policy.rule: Preserve exact source references in metadata and current story-facing briefs, but never make spelling, initials, coat of arms, readable port signage, fixed architectural brand or a repeated black-wax emblem necessary to the image.
proper_name_policy.pass_test: Replace every current proper noun with a neutral functional label. If the visual dramaturgy collapses, re-brief.
functional_spine: experimental cargo of unresolved benefit or harm
missing command figure whose fate remains unknown
possible hostile network without conclusive visual identity
irreversible route choice made by players

research_basis.use: Method and critique calibration only; no style copying and no external lore.

sources.lesson: Separate art notes, artist specification, sketch approval and final approval.
State mandatory kernels clearly and leave room for the artist to improve the solution.
Give structural feedback before rendering and judge at final card scale; detailed brief and creative latitude need staged approval.
Use observed horizon, weather and ship relationships; derive line from witness, not from a generic engraving filter.
Treat quarantine as waiting water, cargo procedure and infrastructure rather than a single plague icon.

principles: Arden’s plague pressure appears through quarantine infrastructure, strained supply and sealed cargo; widespread suffering is not used as decorative spectacle.
Experimental theriac cargo travels from San Cordelio to Saint Verena’s quarantine anchorage; no readable İLAÇ label or invented copy appears in art.
Veyr’s compound remains treatment/poison/failed hypothesis ambiguity; no cure color, poison color, healed patient or dead patient proves an answer.
Gusto’s disappearance is conveyed only through absence, missing pages or an unoccupied command position; no image determines his fate or allegiance.
Black wax is never a stable logo, Hain marker, back-face code or conclusive evidence. When contextually present, it may be indistinguishable from soot, tar or ordinary dark wax.
CAN-03 and CAN-04 govern every application: no image closes the mystery.
v27_narrative_visual_spine.non_forcing_rule: No narrative clue is added to other cards merely to repeat the plot.
v27_narrative_visual_spine.naming_rule: All proper nouns are current source labels, not aesthetic pillars. Art binds to narrative function and must survive later renaming.

single_main_action_audit.rule: One visual predicate per record; contextual states and causal traces may remain in other fields.
